prompts.Vertin_head_south:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
IMAGE 1 is the exact existing RimWorld pawn texture to EDIT. IMAGE 2 is the original MIS_arknights game-texture reference board; imitate its thick black outlines and compact 2D local-color rendering.
Change ONLY drawing/inking/detail treatment. Preserve the character identity, exact view direction, major silhouette, pose, proportions, feature positions, costume pieces, colors and their arrangement from image 1. This is not a redesign. Follow image 1, not the reference characters' anatomy/accessories.
Main correction: MUCH BOLDER BLACK OUTLINE around the entire silhouette and major overlapping components. At final game size, aim for 2–3 native pixels of clean near-black outer line; major hair locks, clothing boundaries and pouch outlines 1–1.5 native pixels. Thick even readable contour like Thorns/Texas. Retain a clean thin antialiased edge; no blurry halo or soft shadow.
Simplify surface detail into broad clear matte shapes: at most 2 or 3 restrained tones per material. Remove fine scratches, thin hair streaks, embroidery micro-patterns, realistic cloth texture, smooth photographic gradients and little glossy reflections. Keep the significant identifying ornaments as simple outlined shapes. Readability at small game scale comes first. Interior should not become a solid black blob: distinguish the local dark gray/plum/ivory colors with clear large areas separated by black lines.
Genuine TRANSPARENT background. ONE sprite of the same part as image 1. No extra characters, labels, grid, text, backing color, ground or cast shadow. All visible original parts complete, nothing cropped. Do not add arms, hands, backpack, straps, tools or weapons. Keep roughly the same crop/framing as image 1.
HEAD ONLY. Preserve face shape, eye size and placement, hair length and direction, no added neck/shoulders. Keep the existing mature face proportions rather than baby-chibi eyes or round cheeks. Ink jaw, ears and hair outline clearly but keep facial strokes modest enough for readability. Consolidate hair into a few clear locks and broad matte highlight areas.
Keep Vertin's ash-beige side-parted hair, gray-green eyes, low dark plum top hat, blue-gray band/bow/two ribbon tails with black tips, in the same placement. Preserve these major accessories while using thick black outlines and broad matte fills.
